question: When was the International Day of the Girl Child 2021 celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11 October.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **International Day of the Girl Child:-**

 
 
• It is celebrated **every year on October 11th **to highlight the challenges that **girls face and promote their empowerment.**
 
• The first Day of the Girl Child was observed on October 11, 2012.
 
• The International Day of the Girl Child was established on October 11 by Resolution 66/170, which was approved by the UN General Assembly on December 19, 2011.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
